description:
### **About Us**

Global, inclusive and innovative - welcome to AMS, where talent connects across cultures and backgrounds to shape the future of work.

We work with leading organizations to design and deliver talent strategies that bring together people, process, data and technology, helping millions of people find meaningful work every year. Our diverse, connected community collaborates to create results for clients and opportunities for our people to learn, grow and make an impact.

At AMS, we look for people who bring more than experience, and we welcome different perspectives and ways of thinking.

  

### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Recruiter with strong expertise in hiring for Trade Sales roles (General Trade & Modern Trade) within the manufacturing sector. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of sourcing and closing sales talent across distribution, channel, and retail-facing functions, working closely with regional and zonal business leaders.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for General Trade (GT) and Modern Trade (MT) sales roles — from Territory Sales Officer to Regional/Zonal Sales Manager level
* Partner with Sales Leadership, Regional Business Heads, and HRBPs to understand hiring needs across territories and zones
* Drive pan-India hiring for field sales roles, including remote/on-ground hiring drives in Tier 2/3 towns and rural markets
* Source and build talent pipelines for niche sales profiles — Key Account Managers, Distributor Sales Managers, Channel Sales Managers
* Conduct market mapping of competitor organizations (FMCG, consumer durables, beverages) to benchmark sourcing strategy
* Manage high-volume hiring for junior/mid-level field sales roles alongside niche/leadership hiring for senior sales positions
* Coordinate interviews, manage offer negotiations, and ensure smooth onboarding, including for candidates in remote locations
* Track and report hiring metrics (TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source-wise effectiveness) to leadership
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships for regional/local hiring support where needed
* Ensure compliance with company hiring policies and budget/compensation guidelines across territories

### **Skills & Requirements**

* 5–10 years of recruitment experience, with significant exposure to Trade Sales hiring (GT/MT) in manufacturing, FMCG, or consumer durables
* Proven experience hiring across multiple geographies/territories, including rural/semi-urban markets
Strong understanding of sales hierarchy and career paths within trade sales (TSO ASM RSM* ZSM)
* Excellent stakeholder management skills — ability to work with regional sales leadership across zones
* Hands-on experience with ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and other sourcing channels
* Ability to manage high-volume + niche hiring simultaneously
* Strong negotiation and offer management skills

### **Why AMS?**

At AMS, we come from every walk of life - and that’s what makes us unique. Our culture is open, inclusive and built on trust. We empower our people with the flexibility and autonomy to work in ways that bring out their best. We offer career opportunities in every direction you want to explore.

**We offer**

* Growth and development focused on your strengths
* The opportunity to develop a career within one of the world’s leading organisations specialising in talent and workforce solutions.
* A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic
* Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* Volunteer day - you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you
* A competitive reward and benefits package\* (private medical care, life insurance, etc.)
* Flexibility in how and where you work\*
* Hybrid model [when applies - details]

  

* Details may vary slightly depending on your location, local labour law, etc.

**Our statement**

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate based upon age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

If you require any accommodations or have any accessibility needs, please reach out via email [email protected] or make a member of our Talent Acquisition team aware at any time.

If you’re ready to bring your skills, curiosity, and passion, click **Apply** and let’s explore what we can achieve together!

description:
Req ID: 64332

Job Function: Strategy, Transformation & Business Intelligence

Posting Start Date: 06/11/2026

Posting End Date: 12/11/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Amy Hunt**

**Career Grade: D**

**About the role**
------------------

The Portfolio Lead: PMO Specialist is the operational partner to Product, Engineering and Delivery leadership for an assigned portfolio. The role turns strategic priorities and roadmaps into realistic, funded and measurable delivery plans, giving leaders confidence that commitments are achievable, sustainable and focused on value.
  
The role connects Portfolio planning, Financial management, FinOps, Workforce and capacity, Delivery insight, Governance, Dependencies, Quality and continuous improvement. It provides a trusted view of portfolio health and supports timely, evidence-based decisions.
  
Although embedded within a portfolio, the role operates as part of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community. It adopts common BT standards, tooling, data definitions and governance approaches, and contributes learning back into the community rather than creating local practices in isolation.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**Portfolio planning and strategic alignment**

* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders and Delivery Leads to translate strategic objectives and roadmaps into executable portfolio plans.
* Coordinate quarterly, monthly and ongoing portfolio planning, integrating demand, capacity, funding, dependencies and delivery readiness.
* Provide scenario analysis and recommendations to support prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs.
* Maintain an evidence-based view of commitments, milestones, outcomes and delivery confidence.
* Provide complete, timely and evidence-based portfolio inputs into unit-level planning, reporting and assurance, using agreed definitions, standards and reporting cycles.
  

**Financial Insight, Investment Traceability and FinOps**

* Maintain an integrated view of portfolio investment, financial forecasts and actual expenditure, using Finance-owned information to connect financial performance with delivery progress and expected outcomes.
* Embed FinOps practices so cloud cost, consumption and value are considered in planning, prioritisation and delivery decisions.
* Monitor material cost trends, forecast variance, commitments and optimisation opportunities, ensuring accountable owners understand the insight and act.
* Coordinate reviews and follow-up where expenditure or forecast performance is outside agreed expectations.
* Ensure new demand, proofs of concept and material scope changes identify funding, cloud-cost implications and ongoing run-cost impact before commitment.
* Support consistent cost allocation, tagging, chargeback and showback, escalating data-quality or ownership gaps.
  

**Delivery performance, insight and forecasting**

* Establish measures covering outcomes, value, predictability, flow, quality and delivery health.
* Turn complex portfolio data into concise insight, options and recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Maintain delivery forecasts and identify trends, constraints and opportunities early.
* Focus reporting on changes, exceptions, risks, decisions and outcomes rather than routine activity.
  

**Capacity, workforce and partner planning**

* Maintain a portfolio view of demand, capacity, skills and constraints across employees, partners and suppliers.
* Coordinate capacity and scenario planning to identify gaps, bottlenecks and required interventions.
* Facilitate prioritisation when demand exceeds capacity and provide forward-looking workforce insight.
  

**Risk, dependency, quality and assurance**

* Coordinate cross-team, cross-programme and cross-portfolio risks, issues and dependencies.
* Work with accountable owners on mitigation, resolution and escalation.
* Provide proportionate assurance that plans are realistic, funded, governed and supported by delivery evidence.
* Champion quality through visibility of technical debt, defects, rework, reliability and operational readiness.
  

**PMO standards, governance and tooling**

* Operate as a member of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community, not as a standalone portfolio function.
* Apply agreed BT delivery standards, PMO controls, planning methods, data definitions, governance cadences and reporting practices.
* Maintain a single source of truth for commitments, milestones, dependencies, risks, financial insight and delivery confidence using agreed tooling.
* Design proportionate governance that provides transparency and control without unnecessary overhead.
* Share learning, support peer assurance and improve consistency across portfolios.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Commercial thinker** : Connects delivery choices to investment, cost, consumption, value and sustainable outcomes.
* **Portfolio planning** : Integrates strategy, demand, funding, capacity and dependencies into realistic scenarios.
* **Data and insight** : Creates a trusted performance view and translates complexity into clear recommendations.
* **Governance and assurance** : Applies proportionate controls, standards and escalation while protecting pace.
* **Collaborative partner** : Builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance, Architecture, Commercial and Assurance.
* **Solution-focused achiever** : Resolves obstacles and maintains momentum in ambiguity.
* **Improvement focus** : Coordinates sustainable improvements across teams and portfolios.
* **Digital fluency** : Uses Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or equivalent portfolio tools.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Significant experience in portfolio management, PMO, delivery operations, programme delivery or a comparable complex environment.
* Experience across multiple Product, Engineering and Delivery teams with significant dependencies and competing priorities.
* Practical experience of planning, forecasting, capacity management and delivery insight.
* Experience managing or assuring financial information, forecasts, portfolio costs or related commercial controls.
* Experience applying governance, reporting and data standards across multiple teams.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear, evidence-based insight.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving experience.
* Product operating models and Lean Portfolio Management.
* FinOps in cloud-enabled portfolios.
* SAFe RTE, portfolio, programme or equivalent accreditation.
* Building or improving PMO or Delivery Operations capability.
* Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

  

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

  

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

  

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**About the role**
------------------

The Data Governance Manager manages a team of data governance professionals and oversees the implementation of BT's data governance strategy, driving adherence to related policy and standards, whilst ensuring data remains accurate, consistent, secure, and aligned with strategic objectives.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead the roadmap and operating model for data quality, catalogue, lineage, business glossary and taxonomy controls.
* Manage, coach and set priorities for a team of four, creating clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain control requirements, data quality dimensions, rules, thresholds, scorecards and escalation routes for critical data.
* Drive the cataloguing of data assets and critical data elements, including ownership, definitions, classification and lineage.
* Establish and govern enterprise business glossary and taxonomy standards so that data is described consistently across BT.
* Work with Data Owners, Data Stewards, engineering and platform teams to embed controls into data products, pipelines and delivery processes.
* Oversee data quality issue management, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, validation and closure based on business and risk impact.
* Develop dashboards and management information that show control effectiveness, exceptions, trends and areas requiring intervention.
* Maintain clear control evidence and support internal assurance, audit and regulatory reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate controls and integrate governance requirements into cloud and enterprise data platforms.
* Build adoption through practical guidance, training and engagement with business and technology teams.
* Monitor market, regulatory and technology developments and continuously improve the control framework.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, data controls or a related data-management discipline in a large or complex organisation.
* Experience leading people or multidisciplinary delivery teams, with the ability to set direction, manage priorities and develop capability.
* Practical experience designing or operating data quality controls, including profiling, rules, thresholds, monitoring, issue management and remediation.
* Strong knowledge of data catalogues, metadata, lineage, business glossaries, taxonomies, critical data elements and data ownership or stewardship models.
* Experience translating policy and risk requirements into operational processes, controls, evidence and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of recognised data-management or control frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, COBIT or equivalent.
* Experience with governance and data-quality platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Ataccama, Dataplex, Databricks, Ab Initio or equivalent.
* Ability to use dashboards and management information to explain control performance, risks and priorities to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across business, engineering, platform, risk, compliance and assurance teams.
* Understanding of privacy, security, records and regulatory expectations relevant to enterprise data, including GDPR.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience embedding or automating governance controls in cloud data platforms, particularly GCP, or through policy-as-code approaches.
* Experience supporting data or AI governance, audit readiness and control assurance in a regulated organisation.

The **Search & Referrals team** owns Tide's marketing website and leads the expansion of our referral programme. We are responsible for designing growth loops, scaling user acquisition initiatives, and building product experiences that contribute to Tide's growth. You will work closely with the team to deliver impactful solutions across Tide's marketing and referral experiences.

As a **Staff Mobile Engineer** at Tide you will be working on the designing, creating and running the rich product catalogue in one of our **Business** **areas,** working across multiple teams. We have a long roadmap ahead of us and rarely run out of interesting problems to tackle.

We work in small autonomous teams, grouped under common domains owning the micro-frontends that makes Tide a great application. The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. * **Keep it up.** Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.

* **Make it easy to get help.** One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
* **Be Customer Zero.** Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

**What it's like to join at this level:** You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. * Own root-cause analysis and resolution for application bugs and recurring failures, and close RCAs with verified fixes.
* Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.
* Prioritize technical debt against the backlog to improve stability, and recommend fixes.

* Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .

**Job Description:**

**Lead Grid Connection Engineer**
=================================

  

**Fluence Office:** IND-Bangalore/Remote

  

**Reports to:** Grid Connection Director, Australia as part of the APAC Delivery group. Will be involved in leading, managing and performing grid connection studies.

  

**About us:** Fluence is a global leader in energy storage solutions, revolutionizing the way we integrate renewable energy into electricity systems. We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Grid Connections Engineer to play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless integration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support assessment of BESS solutions to comply with Generator Performance Standards (GPS) for grid connections.

* Manage grid modelling studies for BESS system grid connections, including model troubleshooting and technical support.

* Undertake preliminary modelling and assessments (such as Model Acceptance Tests)

* Management and provision of R0, R1 and commissioning (R2) documents and technical information (such as performance curves, datasheets, model user guides (RUGs) etc.) and provision of project-specific documents when required.

* Collaboration with design teams for preparation of key design items affecting grid connections, including voltage control strategy, plant performance curves etc,

* Review and inform BESS and BoP designs for grid connected BESS assets to ensure GPS and Registration compliance.

* Manage stakeholders (internal, customer, consultant, regulatory etc.) to ensure grid connections are achieved end-to-end in a timely manner, including attending meetings and providing progress reports.

* Assist technical teams in maintaining and updating proprietary PPC and OEM dynamic models.

* Coach and work collaboratively with other engineers within the organization.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Conduct feasibility and locational studies utilising dynamic and grid models to identify and evaluate opportunities.

* Support modelling requirements and activities in the Asia-Pacific region.

* Collaborate with technical teams to develop new PCS/PPC solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering degree in Electrical or Power Systems

* PhD or Master’s in Power Systems preferred

**Competencies**

* Minimum 5+ Years of professional experience in Power system Analysis.

* Experience in review of grid connection compliance design.

* National Electricity Market (NEM) grid connection experience, especially BESS Generator Performance Standards (GPS) and Registration experience preferred.

* Generator and power systems modelling experience.

* Experience with PSS/E, PSCAD, PowerFactory software.

* Experience in negotiation with major stakeholders, such as clients, consultants, contractors and authorities.

• Experience in high pressure environment.

**Our Culture**

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.

**Infinite Impact**

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.

**All In**

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

Civil Engineering

MUM0000BF Requisition #

**Joining Arup**
  
  
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.  
  
  
  
  
**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a motivated and technically competent Civil Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and delivery of infrastructure, mix used development, airports, data centre projects.The role will involve civil engineering design across the project lifecycle, including site development, grading, drainage, roads and pavements, underground utilities, external works, and coordination with structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. The successful candidate should have strong technical fundamentals and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams on complex and fast-paced projects. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the role will take technical ownership of design packages and drive the development of safe, compliant, and well‑coordinated design solutions, with a focus on utilities such as water, electricity, telecoms, and highways‑related works.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

The role involves delivering civil engineering design for data centres, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Responsibilities include site grading, earthworks, roads, pavements, drainage, external works, and utility infrastructure design. The engineer will develop stormwater drainage strategies, coordinate finished levels, utilities, attenuation, and discharge requirements. The role requires preparation and review of calculations, drawings, specifications, technical reports, and design documentation. Coordination with structural, architectural, MEP, BIM, geotechnical, landscape, and other disciplines is essential. The engineer will review surveys, site investigation information, contractor drawings, RFIs, and technical submissions. Responsibilities also include identifying and managing design risks, clashes, interfaces, and constructability issues. Designs must comply with Indian Standards, local authority requirements, client standards, and relevant international codes. The role includes client and authority coordination for technical approvals and consents. The engineer will review and oversee 3D designs using Autodesk Civil 3D and ensure BIM compliance with ISO 19650. Responsibilities also include mentoring junior engineers, maintaining quality standards, and supporting project planning, fee proposals, resources, bids, and business development.

**Is this role right for you?**

* Minimum 8 years’ experience with a degree in Civil, Utilities, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related discipline
* Strong experience in civil infrastructure design, particularly drainage, highways, utilities, grading, earthworks, roads, and external works.
* Advanced working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D, including reviewing and guiding 3D model development.
* Experience with drainage/hydraulic modelling, SuDS, stormwater management, and flood-risk considerations.
* Good understanding of Indian and international design standards, regulations, technical approvals, and authority requirements.
* Sound knowledge of BIM processes and ISO 19650, with experience managing design deliverables
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and manage client relationships..
* Chartered Engineer (CEng/ICE) or near chartership preferred, with experience mentoring and developing junior engineers
* Strong communication, technical report writing, leadership, and decision-making skills, with a proactive and quality-focused approach

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Nisha.Gulati-nisha.gulati@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

**Reward and Benefits**

We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.

**Different people, shared values.**

At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.

At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.

At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.

At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.

**What happens next?**

If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

  

We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

**Job requirements**

The Grade 2 Senior Executive, Group Retiree Administration, is responsible for independently managing retiree benefit administration activities, including participant record maintenance, demographic updates, enrollments, elections, coverage changes, claim registration, and case management. **JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Senior Specialist – Group Retiree Administration**

**Grade** **2 |** **Benefit Operations**

**Function**

Group Retiree Administration

**Role purpose**

Independently deliver accurate, timely and compliant administration for Group Retiree clients and participants.

**Role Summary**

The Grade 2 Senior Executive supports the end-to-end administration of Group Retiree benefits. The role independently manages assigned work, applies documented procedures and client requirements, maintains accurate participant records, resolves routine exceptions, and escalates risks or complex cases promptly. The role works closely with onshore administration, client account, configuration, billing, carrier and technology teams to support a reliable retiree experience.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**Participant,** **eligibility** **and enrollment administration**

* Create and maintain retiree and dependent records in approved administration systems based on authorized client or participant information.

* Process retiree demographic updates, including additions, address changes, dependent changes and other approved record corrections.

* Process enrollment and election activity, administrative life events, newly retired transactions, coverage changes and terminations in line with documented rules and effective dates.

* Validate participant, plan, coverage, eligibility and effective-date information before completing transactions or submitting work for approval.

* Maintain clear case notes and an accurate audit trail for every transaction.

**Case,** **claim** **and work-queue management**

* Own assigned administration cases, service requests and claim-registration activities from receipt through closure within agreed service levels.

* Monitor assigned queues and aged inventory, including daily review of 1F and other designated cases, and take action to prevent backlog accumulation.

* Investigate routine discrepancies, identify missing or inconsistent information, complete permitted corrections and route complex matters to the appropriate owner .

* Provide timely status updates, document blockers and follow through until resolution.

* Support operational recovery plans and priority work during peak periods, system cutovers and open enrollment.

**Discrepancy reporting,** **quality** **and controls**

* Prepare, review and complete weekly discrepancy reports within committed timelines.

* Perform checks for completeness, accuracy, duplicate activity, effective dates and alignment with client requirements and SOPs.

* Complete peer review or maker-checker controls where required and respond promptly to quality feedback.

* Protect confidential participant and client information and follow applicable privacy, security, access and records-management requirements.

* Escalate data issues, system defects, recurring errors, SLA risks and control gaps with supporting evidence.

* Identify repeat issues and practical opportunities to improve accuracy, turnaround time, controls and participant service.

* Participate in small improvement initiatives, testing, knowledge-transfer and cross-training activities.

* Support new client, renewal and open-enrollment readiness activities assigned to administration, including validation of participant impacts and completion of required administrative updates.

* Provide day-to-day guidance to newer colleagues on documented processes without assuming formal people-management accountability.

**Systems and Tools**

* Use Microsoft Excel for reconciliations, trackers, discrepancy analysis and operational reporting; use Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams for documentation and collaboration.

* Follow access controls and use only approved locations for storing participant, client and operational information.

**Knowledge,** **Skills** **and Behaviors**

* Working knowledge of US health and retiree benefits administration, including eligibility, enrollment, demographic maintenance and participant servicing.

* Ability to interpret client requirements, SOPs, plan rules and effective-date logic and apply them consistently.

* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.

* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to ask focused questions and escalate risks early.

* Ability to prioritize multiple work items, meet deadlines and maintain quality in a high-volume environment.

* Intermediate Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills.

* Collaborative, accountable, adaptable and comfortable working across time zones and shifts.

**Experience and Eligibility**

* Minimum 3.5 years of overall relevant experience, preferably in US health, benefits administration, insurance operations or a comparable regulated service environment.

* Demonstrated experience independently processing operational transactions, resolving cases and meeting quality and service-level expectations.

* Internal applicants should meet the organization’s current mobility, conduct and performance eligibility requirements.

* Flexibility to work in shifts based on business and client requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Assigned cases, claims and discrepancy work are completed accurately and within agreed service levels.

* Participant records and case documentation are complete, consistent and auditable.

* Backlogs, aged items, repeat errors and operational risks are identified early and actively managed.

* Stakeholders receive clear status updates, and dependencies are followed through to closure.

* Process knowledge is shared, SOPs remain current, and practical improvements are implemented.

**Note:** This description reflects the Grade 2 scope for Group Retiree Administration. Responsibilities may be adjusted to meet client, regulatory, technology and operating -model requirements.

At Siemens Energy India Limited, we are more than just an energy technology company. We develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in Siemens Energy’s research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. **Your new role - Challenging and Future - Oriented**

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be the trusted hiring advisor to senior leaders across Engineering, Operations, Projects, EHS and Commercial. You will own full-cycle recruitment for mid-to-senior technical and leadership roles across our power and energy manufacturing, services and project businesses.

This is not a requisition-fulfilment role. You will anticipate workforce needs, shape hiring strategy with business leaders, build talent pipelines ahead of demand, and bring market insight into decisions made at VP, Director and Plant/Project leadership level.

**What You Will Do**

Own end-to-end hiring

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for a portfolio of technical and leadership roles, from intake to offer to onboarding, with minimal reliance on agencies.
* Recruit and advise on talent for critical energy-transition and industrial technology capabilities including:
* Gas turbines, steam turbines and generators
* Grid technologies, HV/MV systems and substation engineering
* EPC and project execution leadership
* Manufacturing and supply-chain operations
* Service engineering and field service organizations
* Process safety, quality and EHS leadership
* Grid modernization and decarbonization-related functions

Partner with senior stakeholders

* Serve as the primary talent advisor to Business Unit Heads, Plant Leaders, Project Directors and functional executives.
* Influence hiring decisions through market intelligence, competitive benchmarking and talent insights.
* Challenge workforce assumptions, hiring specifications and compensation strategies using data and external market evidence.
* Facilitate calibration discussions for critical leadership hires and succession-related recruitment.
* Challenge hiring assumptions constructively, advocate for diverse slates and drive structured, consistent interviews.
* Work across multiple business units and approval layers, balancing competing priorities with clear communication.

Lead Talent Intelligence and Market Insights

* Develop talent maps for critical competitor organizations and adjacent industries.
* Advise business leaders on talent availability, movement patterns and compensation trends across energy, industrial manufacturing, EPC and infrastructure sectors.
* Present hiring market insights and recommendations to leadership teams.
* Support location and workforce planning decisions using external labor-market intelligence.

Drive TA excellence

* Track and improve funnel conversion, time-to-fill, drive & improve gender diversity, offer acceptance, direct sourcing and interview effectiveness.
* Manage search partners, vendors and niche technical job boards to deliver quality and value.
* Help shape TA processes, tools and employer branding as the business grows.

What You Bring

* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including significant experience partnering with senior business leaders in industrial, energy, infrastructure, manufacturing or engineering-intensive environments.
* Demonstrated success influencing workforce and talent decisions beyond recruitment execution.
* Experience advising leaders on talent strategy, workforce planning, organizational growth and succession-related hiring.
* Strong understanding of talent dynamics across energy, industrial manufacturing, EPC, utilities or heavy engineering sectors.
* Experience hiring across manufacturing plants, field service organizations, engineering centers and project execution environments.
* Familiarity with regulated, safety-critical and asset-intensive industries.
* Ability to navigate matrixed global organizations and complex stakeholder environments.
* Proficiency with an ATS (Workday, SuccessFactors or equivalent), LinkedIn Recruiter and advanced sourcing tools.
* A data-driven approach to recruiting, using funnel metrics, source-of-hire and time-to-fill analysis.

How You Work

* Executive Advisor: builds credibility with senior leaders and influences talent decisions through expertise, insight and data.
* Business Curious: understands manufacturing economics, project execution, service models and operational drivers, not just recruiting processes.
* External Lens: continuously brings market intelligence, competitor insights and workforce trends into business discussions.
* Talent Strategist: thinks beyond current vacancies to future capability requirements and succession pipelines.
* Execution Excellence: combines strategic thinking with disciplined delivery and measurable outcomes.

What We Offer

* Strategic scope with direct visibility to senior business leaders.
* The chance to shape TA practice, tools and processes at a key growth stage.
* Work on the energy transition, with a global brand and a purpose-led mission.
* Competitive compensation with a performance-linked variable component.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry.

Siemens Energy India is committed to equal opportunity and a diverse, inclusive workplace.
